resources.string: Grant overlay and enable the Volume accessibility service so hardware volume keys show the WP8.1 volume HUD instead of Android\'s stock panel. Notification access unlocks music transport for third-party players; Metro Music works without it.
Grant overlay permission and enable the accessibility service first.
Ready. Press Volume Up or Down to show the Metro volume controls.
Metro Volume listens for volume keys and draws the WP8.1 volume HUD above other apps.
